mission: Capacity75 session 10 (2026-10-11): resolver 1.3 - stop discovery_run_id from re-versioning unchanged source-mapping proposals (2,164 versions/24h vs 47 real changes), with a strict bridge so physical-artwork reviews bound under 1.2 never lose their link and never transfer across a real evidence change; sequential collector release

impacts.reason: Collector runtime code (both images import source_mapping_proposals). evidence_digest excludes discovery_run_id (still recorded in evidence_summary_json); RESOLVER_VERSION 1.3; physical_artwork_proof bridge accepts a 1.2 review only if the capture cursor stored summary hashes to its baseline (1.2) and equals current evidence except discovery_run_id. Delivered to all ten collectors one at a time; API by its GitHub build. No identity guard, resolution, approval fence, sale policy, schedule, budget, pacing or freshness change; nothing auto-approved.

Unchanged listing across runs reused; real change re-versions; hard guard: approved exact groups with physical proofs keep row/digest/version/approval/proof (fails on 1.2 code); 1.2 review bridge re-attaches only on identical evidence and refuses on any change or cursor tampering.

resources.name: Staging Postgres (no migration; ordinary scheduled captures only)

routes: Existing admitted recurring Yuyu discovery turns persist proposals; no new source request, endpoint or manual invocation
dependencies: source_mapping_proposal_groups (no schema change; f9e5b4a8c012); positive_physical_artwork.json registry unchanged; freshness admission unchanged
impact.deployment_impact: Collectors have no GitHub trigger (session 9; enforced by the PR #102 preflight), so this merge builds no collector. The sequential delivery uploads the merge to each collector ONE AT A TIME in its own safe slot and verifies before the next; any failure restores every touched collector to its verified a852244 image. One-time re-version of current pending proposal groups (~2.2k rows, ~4-5 MB ESTIMATE), then ~47/day. Approved groups are never re-planned (mapped listings produce no plan; reviewed groups preserved).

recovery.procedure: Automatic during rollout: every touched collector restored newest-first to its verified a852244 image (deployments in collector_services) via collector_variables.restore. After delivery: python3 scripts/collector_variables.py --service <name> --commit a8522447c6933d05e94e01d5789cdcd5160c10da --expect-digest <digest from session-8 fleet-after-pr98.json> --restore --set RAW_DICTIONARY_STORAGE_ENABLED=true --set RAW_DICTIONARY_STORAGE_MODE=daily-v1 --set APP_ENV=staging, one at a time. Rows written under 1.3 remain valid history; 1.2 code re-versions pending groups once more.
recovery.trigger: any drop in approved exact (2,019 Yuyu / 151 SNKR) or approved-with-proof (298) counts; any stored proposal differs RuntimeError; any discovery failure; any 403/429/challenge; deployment failure; schedule or flag drift; re-versioning still > 200/day after the first full discovery cycle
recovery.backup: No schema change. Completed manual staging Postgres backup 2135eec8 at 2026-10-11T15:20:25Z (<1h old at release) plus daily schedule 09:22Z (session-10 handoff evidence/backups-final.json). Verified a852244 images active and redeployable at 15:32Z (evidence/live-after-pr102.json).

verification.observation_window: Delivery artifact plus one completed natural discovery turn per Yuyu shard on the new code. Then: approved exact 2,019/151 and approved-with-proof 298 unchanged; one-time re-version of pending groups only; second-cycle versions ~ changed listings only (rollback if > 200/day); 0 stored-proposal-differs errors; 0 discovery failures; lossless green; proposal table growth over 24h.
